snippet.title: Perfect Hue Arena - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Perfect Hue Arena, where colors clash! Throw RGB pucks that stun your opponent, or transform into a pool of pixels to evade. There are 6 game modes that can be played as casually or competitively as you want, and a variety of items to explore.

Available free to play: https://perfecthue.tv/arena

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3961650/Perfect_Hue_Arena/
